class.name: InterDVDMenuPage
class.brief_description: A VMGM or VTSM menu page that compiles to [InterDVDMenu].
class.description: 720×480 Control. [constant InterDVDMenu.MENU_TITLE] menus mux into [code]VIDEO_TS.VOB[/code]. Other types mux into [code]VTS_01_0.VOB[/code]. Default [member still_time] is 0 so VLC does not freeze on the title menu. Child [InterDVDHotspot] nodes are the menu buttons.

method.name: add_hotspot
method.description: Appends a hotspot child and returns it.

method.name: compile_menu
method.description: Builds the menu resource (destinations are resolved by [method InterDVDDisc.build_project]).

members.member: Bake length when [member source] is [constant InterDVDChapter.SOURCE_SCENE].
Background scene when [member source] is [constant InterDVDChapter.SOURCE_SCENE].
Video file or PackedScene for the menu cell.
Background video when [member source] is [constant InterDVDChapter.SOURCE_VIDEO].
Menu PGC still time. Keep 0 on VMGM title menus.
